content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment processing platforms like Stripe and Gumroad may be convenient, but they come with a number of drawbacks. They often have strict restrictions on who can use their services, and they can be slow to process payments. This can lead to delayed payouts, lost revenue, and a lack of control over your finances. In contrast, NOWPayments is a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure that allows you to set up your own payment processing pipeline, giving you full control over your finances and eliminating the risk of delayed payouts. With NOWPayments, you can accept payments in multiple cryptocurrencies, including USDT, and enjoy low transaction fees, making it the perfect solution for creators in regions where traditional payment processing is restricted.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy your NOWPayments digital store, you'll need to have a few things in place. First, you'll need to have a digital product to sell, such as an ebook or a course. You'll also need to have a NOWPayments account, which can be set up in just a few minutes. Additionally, you'll need to have a way to deliver your digital product to your customers, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, you'll need to have a payment method, such as a cryptocurrency wallet, to receive payments from your customers.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have everything in place, it's time to set up your payment and delivery pipeline. This involves setting up your NOWPayments account, configuring your payment settings, and connecting your delivery pipeline. With NOWPayments, you can set up a payment gateway that accepts multiple cryptocurrencies, including USDT, and enjoy low transaction fees. You can also set up a delivery pipeline that automatically delivers your digital product to your customers the moment payment is received.
You can set up a NOWPayments digital store in just a few minutes and start receiving crypto payments for your digital products.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. This involves testing your payment gateway and delivery pipeline to ensure that everything is working properly. With NOWPayments, you can test your payment gateway and delivery pipeline in a sandbox environment before going live, ensuring that everything is working properly. Once you're ready, you can go live and start processing transactions.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your NOWPayments digital store is up and running, you can start scaling your operations to meet the demands of your growing customer base. With NOWPayments, you can easily add more payment methods, increase your transaction limits, and configure your delivery pipeline to meet your specific needs. You can also use the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack, giving you the flexibility and control you need to succeed.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

Getting paid in crypto is operationally simpler than it appears. You configure your wallet address in NOWPayments once — this takes under 30 minutes. From that point, every sale deposits automatically into your wallet without any action required from you. The transaction hash in your order log is cryptographic proof of every payment. When you want to convert to local currency, you transfer USDT from your wallet to your exchange account and post a P2P sell order. The buyer sends local currency to your bank account or mobile money account and you release the USDT. Most P2P transactions complete in under 30 minutes.
You can use NOWPayments to accept payments in multiple cryptocurrencies, including USDT, and enjoy low transaction fees.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your NOWPayments digital store, follow these steps: Open your NOWPayments account and set up your payment settings; Configure your payment settings to accept multiple cryptocurrencies, including USDT; Set up your delivery pipeline to automatically deliver your digital product to your customers; Test your payment gateway and delivery pipeline in a sandbox environment; Go live and start processing transactions; Monitor your transactions and adjust your payment and delivery pipeline as needed.
